argv: for d in /home/Scales/One-Wave-Science /home/Scales/Builds /home/Scales/Mythos-and-Stories /home/Scales/One-Wave-Builds; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then printf '\n=== %s ===\n' "$d"; git -C "$d" status --short --branch; git -C "$d" remote -v | sed -n '1,4p'; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; fi; done
intention: Verify the actual local Science, Builds, and Mythos repository checkouts and their clean/dirty state before moving any files across repositories.
consequence: Read-only repository identity and status output only; no files, branches, remotes, commits, or services are changed.
